messages:
mira: Partner Acme reported perf regressions and intermittent OOMs running long-context models on our marketplace AMI. Happens with CUDA 12.3 + NVIDIA driver 536. Can HW/partner folks advise on pin vs hotfix? @kevin @jess
kevin: thanks — do we have a minimal repro and memory trace? :eyes: paste the command & container base image if possible
acme-eng: repro snippet attached in ticket and here:
```
python eval_perf.py --model redwood/paul-large --seq 8192 --batch 1 --device cuda
# OOM at step ~120, resident set keeps growing
```
logs: https://acme.corp/issue/987/logs
jess: we've seen similar regression in our CI on certain kernels — suspect cuBLAS workspace/allocator change in driver 536. Quick mitigation: try pinning to driver 535 + CUDA 12.2, or set env `TF_CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG` (if applicable) as a stopgap.
nate: i can spin a canary marketplace image with driver 535 + CUDA 12.2 pinned. ETA ~3h. will include perf/test harness.
deploy-bot: Canary build started: marketplace-image:canary-3924681120-driver535 (build id: bld_3924681120)
sam: we should prepare a marketplace advisory and manifest change to pin driver at image level if canary is green. i'll draft comms and manifest diff.
jess: runtime team — i'll run the nightly long-seq regression suite against the canary once Nate's image is available. will report throughput & memory deltas.
kevin: also looping partner contact at NVIDIA for driver regression confirmation. requesting known-issues list + recommended kernel flags. @acme-eng please share kernel version in your infra.
mira: action items summary:
 - Nate: create canary image w/ driver 535 + CUDA 12.2 (due in ~3h)
 - Jess: run perf + mem regression suite on canary (due EOD)
 - Sam: draft marketplace advisory + manifest pin PR (due EOD)
 - Kevin: vendor escalation + rollback path (due tomorrow morning)
I'll own partner sync & tracking ticket. :thumbsup:
jess: if canary passes, recommend temporary pin on marketplace AMIs and hold any public CUDA upgrade announcements until root cause fixed. will add perf numbers to ticket.
acme-eng: we'll test the canary in our CI and report pass/fail within 12h. thanks for the rapid turnaround.
kevin: if vendor confirms regression, we should coordinate a hotfix channel with them and schedule joint comms. otherwise plan fallback: rollback driver in marketplace images + hotfix release later.
mira: good. opening a tracking ticket and attaching notes from this thread. if canary fails, fallback plan = runtime micro-patch to force kernel fallback + emergency rollback of AMI.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: RH-9271 (Marketplace Driver Regression) — https://redwood.internal/tickets/RH-9271
mira: i'll follow up with status update when canary completes. please react here with any blockers. :wave:
